en.t: The student slipped through the main gate.

units.source_text: 他绕过敕使门的外侧，伫立在山门前的荷花池畔。

en.t: He went around the outside of the Imperial Messenger Gate and stood still beside the lotus pond in front of the temple gate.

units.source_text: 然后又站立在横跨地面的中国式的石桥上，仰望着耸立的山门。

en.t: Then he stood again on the Chinese-style stone bridge that crossed the ground, gazing up at the towering temple gate.

units.source_text: 我想："他纵火的目标就是那座山门吧？"

en.t: I thought, "Was that temple gate the very target of his arson?"
